summary: Register Shopware 6 as a self-hosted storefront provider (products/inventory/prices/orders/returns) reusing gigachat's self-contained client_credentials OAuth2 pattern and the existing host-injected registry boundary.

impacts.evidence: Shopware accounts are tenant-scoped Connector SDK accounts identical in shape to woocommerce/medusa/opencart/prestashop; the host is admin-supplied per-account non-secret runtime config, the same pattern every self-hosted storefront connector already uses.
The Integration client id/secret stays behind the existing SecretAccessor/UseSecret boundary; product/order projections retain only bounded remote ids, numbers, statuses and amounts.
Shopware reuses the existing generic product/price sync machinery verbatim; no new public HTTP/OpenAPI operation is added.
No EventBus schema is added or changed.

Connector SDK root Connector/Runtime remain frozen; Shopware implements only existing capability-specific ports, no port is added or changed. The connector manages its own OAuth2 client_credentials token, the same self-contained pattern already established by connectors/ai/gigachat -- no change to the host-owned OAuth runtime (ADR-0104/ADR-0108) was needed or made.
No schema change; Shopware uses the same generic non-secret runtime-config store every runtime_config_template connector already uses.

Fixed admin-supplied host, opaque Integration client id/secret behind SecretAccessor, bounded inputs and normalized errors preserve the provider boundary. Product create and webhook receipt return a normalized unsupported error with no faked success, since neither has a safe/verifiable implementation given what this connector's credential and the generic write contract carry.
products.write/prices.write/inventory.write/orders.status.write remain gated by the same capability checks every storefront connector already uses.
Writes flow through the existing fetch-compare-write-reconcile receipt path; no new evidence shape is introduced.

Writes follow the existing fetch-compare-write-reconcile pattern (see docs/connectors/shopware/reconciliation.md); ambiguous transport failures reconcile against a re-fetch rather than retrying blindly.

Outbound authority is the admin-configured store host only, DNS-pinned through the existing SSRF-safe transport; inbound webhook receipt is explicitly unsupported in this task (see capability-audit.md), not silently unverified.
Non-2xx responses and malformed bodies are normalized to bounded errors.
Shopware can be disabled by removing its connector accounts; no schema rollback is needed.

Provider tests, go build/vet/test and the Task-064 conformance candidate pass 12 of 13 checks -- sandbox_isolation could not be exercised because this execution environment cannot create unprivileged Linux user namespaces, an environment constraint shared by every connector's Task-029 probe. docs/connectors/shopware/conformance-report.json records this genuine result rather than a fabricated pass.
